WITH crime_trends AS (
  SELECT 
    offence,
    occurrence_year,
    COUNT(*) AS incident_count
  FROM 
    incidents
  WHERE 
    offence IN ('Robbery', 'B&E', 'Auto Theft', 'Theft Of Motor Vehicle')
  GROUP BY 
    offence, 
    occurrence_year
)
SELECT 
  offence,
  occurrence_year,
  incident_count,
  LAG(incident_count) OVER (PARTITION BY offence ORDER BY occurrence_year) AS previous_year_count
FROM 
  crime_trends
ORDER BY 
  offence, 
  occurrence_year

WITH yearly_change AS (
  SELECT 
    offence,
    SUM(CASE WHEN occurrence_year = 2014 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS count_2014,
    SUM(CASE WHEN occurrence_year = 2015 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS count_2015,
    SUM(CASE WHEN occurrence_year = 2016 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS count_2016,
    SUM(CASE WHEN occurrence_year = 2017 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS count_2017,
    SUM(CASE WHEN occurrence_year = 2018 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS count_2018,
    SUM(CASE WHEN occurrence_year = 2019 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS count_2019,
    SUM(CASE WHEN occurrence_year = 2020 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS count_2020,
    SUM(CASE WHEN occurrence_year = 2021 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS count_2021,
    (count_2021 - count_2014) AS change_2021_2014,
    (count_2020 - count_2014) AS change_2020_2014,
    (count_2019 - count_2014) AS change_2019_2014,
    (count_2018 - count_2014) AS change_2018_2014,
    (count_2017 - count_2014) AS change_2017_2014,
    (count_2016 - count_2014) AS change_2016_2014,
    (count_2015 - count_2014) AS change_2015_2014
  FROM incidents
  GROUP BY offence
)
SELECT 
  offence,
  MAX(change_2021_2014) AS max_change_2021_2014,
  MAX(change_2020_2014) AS max_change_2020_2014,
  MAX(change_2019_2014) AS max_change_2019_2014,
  MAX(change_2018_2014) AS max_change_2018_2014,
  MAX(change_2017_2014) AS max_change_2017_2014,
  MAX(change_2016_2014) AS max_change_2016_2014,
  MAX(change_2015_2014) AS max_change_2015_2014
FROM yearly_change
ORDER BY max_change_2021_2014 DESC
LIMIT 1

WITH monthly_crime_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    strftime('%m', occurrence_date) AS month,
    COUNT(*) AS crime_count
  FROM 
    incidents
  GROUP BY 
    month
),
monthly_average AS (
  SELECT 
    month,
    AVG(crime_count) * 100 / COUNT(*) AS average
  FROM 
    monthly_crime_counts
  GROUP BY 
    month
)
SELECT 
  monthly_crime_counts.month,
  monthly_crime_counts.crime_count,
  monthly_average.average
FROM 
  monthly_crime_counts
JOIN 
  monthly_average ON monthly_crime_counts.month = monthly_average.month
ORDER BY 
  monthly_crime_counts.month

WITH mean_incidents AS (
  SELECT 
    n.neighbourhood_id,
    AVG(i.incident_count) AS mean_incidents
  FROM 
    neighbourhoods n
  JOIN (
    SELECT 
      neighbourhood_id,
      COUNT(*) AS incident_count
    FROM 
      incidents
    GROUP BY 
      neighbourhood_id
  ) i ON n.neighbourhood_id = i.neighbourhood_id
  GROUP BY 
    n.neighbourhood_id
),
std_dev_incidents AS (
  SELECT 
    n.neighbourhood_id,
    AVG(i.incident_count) AS mean_incidents,
    STDDEV(i.incident_count) AS std_dev_incidents
  FROM 
    neighbourhoods n
  JOIN (
    SELECT 
      neighbourhood_id,
      COUNT(*) AS incident_count
    FROM 
      incidents
    GROUP BY 
      neighbourhood_id
  ) i ON n.neighbourhood_id = i.neighbourhood_id
  GROUP BY 
    n.neighbourhood_id
),
anomalies AS (
  SELECT 
    n.neighbourhood_id,
    i.incident_count
  FROM 
    neighbourhoods n
  JOIN (
    SELECT 
      neighbourhood_id,
      COUNT(*) AS incident_count
    FROM 
      incidents
    GROUP BY 
      neighbourhood_id
  ) i ON n.neighbourhood_id = i.neighbourhood_id
  JOIN mean_incidents mi ON n.neighbourhood_id = mi.neighbourhood_id
  JOIN std_dev_incidents sd ON n.neighbourhood_id = sd.neighbourhood_id
  WHERE 
    i.incident_count > mi.mean_incidents + 3 * sd.std_dev_incidents
)
SELECT 
  a.neighbourhood_id,
  a.incident_count
FROM 
  anomalies a
ORDER BY 
  a.neighbourhood_id

    mci_category,
    offence,
    COUNT(*) AS offence_count
  FROM 
    incidents

    mci_category,

  offence_counts.mci_category,
  offence_counts.offence,
  offence_counts.offence_count,
  category_totals.total_offences,

FROM 
  offence_ranks

  offence_rank <= 5
